Lemma
[Positive and negative parts] 1. ch7:7.6\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0164 If $u\in W^1(\Omega )$, then $u^+,u^-,|u|\in W^1(\Omega )$ and \begin{equation} \tag {7.20} Du^+=\begin{cases} Du& u>0,\\ 0& u\leq 0, \end{cases} \quad Du^-=\begin{cases} 0& u\geq 0,\\ Du& u<0, \end{cases} \quad D|u|=\begin{cases} Du& u>0,\\ 0& u=0,\\ -Du& u<0. \end{cases} \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Apply Lemma 7.5 to smooth bounded-slope approximations of the positive part and pass to the limit in (7.16). Obtain the remaining formulas from $u^-=-(-u)^+$ and $|u|=u^+-u^-$.

□
